description: This file defines React hooks and components for implementing sticky headers and scrollable table areas in a React table component, including utility functions, types, and a main hook 'useSticky' for managing sticky state and rendering.

classes.name: StickyState
classes.description: Interface representing the sticky table state, including dimensions and scroll info.

methods.name: useSticky
methods.description: Main hook to add sticky header and scrollable area functionality to react-table instances.

methods.name: useInstance
methods.description: Hook to enhance a react-table instance with sticky table logic and components.

methods.name: StickyWrap
methods.description: Component that wraps a table to provide sticky headers and scrollable viewport.
